# python: support venv also as virtenv

Recognise `.venv` as well as the author's `.virtenv`. **Motivation:** most examples and editors (VS Code's [docs](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/python/environments#_create-a-virtual-environment-in-the-terminal)) use `python3 -m venv .venv`, so checkouts of other people's projects have `.venv`; the dotfiles' helpers know only `.virtenv` ([search](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Akamilsk%2Fdotfiles%20virtenv&type=code)).
